entries.en: Hello |PLAYERNAME|, welcome to the fluid and potion {shop} of Edron.
entries.translated: Hola |PLAYERNAME|, bienvenido al fluido y poción {shop} de Edron.

entries.en: Hello fighter. I guess you are here to {fight} for our noble {cause}.

entries.en: Have you the {animal cure}?
entries.translated: ¿Tienes el {animal cure}?

entries.en: Can I interest you in a trip to the {monument tower}?

entries.en: Want to go back to Yalahar? Just ask me for a free {passage}.
entries.translated: ¿Quieres volver a Yalahar? Pídeme un {passage} gratis.

entries.en: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|... mortal.
entries.translated: Sea saludado, |PLAYERNAME|... mortal.

entries.en: Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|. Did Vascalir send you to me for a {mission}?
entries.translated: Hola, |PLAYERNAME|. ¿Vascalir te envió a mí por un {mission}?

entries.en: Daraman's blessings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|.

entries.en: Ah our human {alliez} have finally arrived! I've already feared zat ze emperor'z forzez had caught you. Your rezilienze and prowezz are imprezzive.
entries.translated: ¡Ah, nuestro humano {alliez} finalmente ha llegado! Ya temía que Zat ze Emperor'z Forzez te hubiera atrapado. Tu rezilienze y prowezz son impresionantes.
